run_NMC_inference: run No-Marginal-Clamping inference on a BMGraph model with a specified number of iterations and seed
run_GlobalMCMC_inference: run Global MCMC inference using NUTS or another algorithm on a BMGraph model with warmup steps
compile_BaseBMGraphInference: compile a BaseBMGraphInference instance by instantiating its implementation class with model attributes and a seed
review_NMC_class: review the NMC class to understand how it performs non-adaptive inference via bmg.InferenceType.NMC
review_GlobalMCMC_class: review the GlobalMCMC class to understand how it performs adaptive MCMC inference with configurable algorithms
